newsitem.title: FINLAND: AKTIA SAYS BIG OWNERS HAS PARTNERSHIP DEAL.
newsitem.headline: AKTIA SAYS BIG OWNERS HAS PARTNERSHIP DEAL.

text.p: Finnish Aktia Bank said on Thursday it had a been advised that its majority shareholders have a partnership agreement obliging partners to offer their shares first to other members when selling shares.
"According to the deal, a party willing to sell its Aktia shares must offer them first to other partners," Aktia said in a statement.

Twenty savings bank foundations and six savings promotion foundations, owning a good 50 percent of Aktia shares, have concluded a partnership agreement with Svenska litteratursallskapet i Finland r.f., Ab Kelonia Oy, Stiftelsen for Abo Akademi and Kolster Oy Ab, Aktia Bank said.
Shareholders wishing to join the partnership agreement after January 1, 1997, are entitled to do so without any new consideration of the matter by the earlier signatories, the bank said.
